parts.name: Fan
parts.Basic_description: This is the fan blade assembly made of aluminum, consisting of multiple blades attached to a central hub.
parts.Functional_description: It rotates to generate airflow by converting rotational motion into air movement.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its central axis when powered by the motor.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the fan, made of durable plastic, providing structural support and housing for the motor.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the fan blades and motor, maintaining stability and alignment during operation.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during operation.
